title: Fix model image input flags + add kimi-k2.6:cloud for vision

changes.reason: glm-5.2:cloud does NOT support image input. It returns '400 this model does not support image input' when image content is sent. Marking it as text-only so OpenClaw strips image content before sending.
kimi-k2.6:cloud DOES support image input (tested with Ollama API). Adding it as a vision-capable model so the COO glass session can use it for image analysis.

businessImpact: VisionClaw app's snapshot feature is broken — agent gets 400 error when image tool results contain image content. This fix enables proper image handling via kimi-k2.6:cloud.
riskLevel: LOW — removing false image capability flag from glm-5.2:cloud prevents errors. Adding kimi-k2.6:cloud is additive.
